g.text: Session state holds the active task and unresolved questions. Reviewed knowledge holds definitions.
Saved data holds evidence snapshots. Show active scope and allow correction or reset; a new advisor
or measure requires a deliberate state update. Chat history alone does not make evidence current.
Measure multi-turn completion, scope carryover, clarification, freshness and cross-advisor leakage.
Proposed session contract. State must remain inspectable and correctable by the user.
